text:
maria: Hey team — PR #4821 is ready from my side, just waiting on merge. buildkite is failing on one integration shard though, can someone take a quick look? :eyes:

jon: pinging @sam and @lee — which test is flapping? I only see a timeout in the summary.

ci-bot: Buildkite: PR #4821 — linux-integ-shard-8 failed (exit 1). Failing step: integration/tests/kv_store_consistency. Artifacts: https://buildkite.example/4821/artifacts/123

sam: grabbing the logs now. quick skim shows a KV timeout: `ERROR: kv_store_consistency: expected 1024 items, got 1018 after 30s` — looks like a transient stall, not a deterministic assertion.

lee: that test has been noisy on shard-8 the last 3 runs, likely infra-related. We can do a targeted rerun for shard-8 instead of full CI.

maria: cool — would a targeted rerun be enough for merge policy? We need at least 2 approvals and green CI (or a green targeted run) to merge.

jon: I can re-run the single shard, but I don't have merge perms. @sam can you trigger a targeted rerun?

sam: done — triggered `bk retry --shard=linux-integ-shard-8` (job 4821-8-rerun). ETA ~4m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: Buildkite: PR #4821 — linux-integ-shard-8 (rerun) started. Job: 4821-8-rerun.

maria: thanks. also leaving a note: if rerun flakes again, I can add a short retry wrapper around the test to make it more resilient, but prefer infra triage first.

lee: agree — infra triage first. If it keeps failing we should add it to flake_quarantine and open follow-up ticket. I'll open one if rerun fails.

ci-bot: Buildkite: PR #4821 — linux-integ-shard-8 (rerun) succeeded. All other shards already green.

jon: green — I'm approving now. maria, once you get a 2nd approval we can merge during the current window.

maria: tagging @lee for second approval — can you take a quick glance at the final diff? I only changed a docstring + small refactor.

lee: looks fine, LGTM. :thumbsup: go ahead and merge after confirming the changelog entry.

maria: confirmed changelog added. merging now. thanks everyone! :tada:

jon: awesome — thanks for the quick follow-up. I'll keep an eye on shard-8 telemetry this week to see if the infra pattern repeats.

sam: noted. will add a short note to the CI incident board if we see >3 flakes on the same shard in 24h.

maria: added a follow-up task: infra: investigate intermittent KV stalls on linux-integ-shard-8 (refs: BK 4821 artifacts).

lee: nice. closing thread once the task is created.

maria: task created: INFRA-1124. closing thread.
